verdict_text: YES. The script verifies shared tensor names and bit-exact equality of all non-MLP tensors across base/ft1/ft2 before merging (Required result step 1), computes each of the 48 MLP tensors in float32 as `base + λ(ft1-base) + λ(ft2-base)` with λ=0.4 against the unmodified base (avoiding the ordering hazard), and leaves all other tensors untouched. It asserts merged==48 and len(out)==114 (Required checks), and writes a single `model.safetensors` with 114 tensors to `out/T4`.
